## MKV Track Organizer 1.0.27

This release fixes MakeMKV Batch for DVD/Blu-ray ISO workflows.

### Changed

- MakeMKV Batch now discovers `.iso` disc images recursively inside the selected source folder.
- ISO sources now use MakeMKV's `iso:<path>` syntax instead of the folder-only `file:<path>` syntax.
- ISO outputs are written to folders named after the ISO file stem.
- MakeMKV Batch labels now refer to disc sources instead of only disc folders.

### Improved

- MakeMKV errors now surface useful robot-mode diagnostics in the summary, including expired or too-old MakeMKV version messages.
